name: Incendia Powder
summary: Incendia Powder is an enchanted ritual catalyst refined to ignite sacred flames. Carried by Horde emissaries into Thousand Needles, the powder is specifically treated with shamanic incantations to invoke the slumbering spirit-beast Arikara atop Darkcloud Pinnacle.

sections.title: A Spark of Summoning
sections.body: Incendia Powder is no mundane explosive or mundane flash powder; it is a purified, ritualistic substance carefully infused with shamanic magic. Enchanted and entrusted to travelers by Magatha Grimtotem on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise, the mixture is designed to react solely with the sacred fire of life burning atop the isolated spires of Darkcloud Pinnacle. Once scattered across the consecrated brazier where the dead are laid to rest, its alchemical and spiritual warding calls forth the vengeful winged serpent Arikara.

sections.title: Uneasy Portents
sections.body: The rites dictating the creation and use of Incendia Powder stem from interpretations shared by the elder shaman Magatha Grimtotem. Believing that shifting traditions and changes in tauren ways had provoked ancient spirits into hunting High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, the powder was enchanted to force the apparition into the open so it could be destroyed. Though it succeeds in calling forth the fierce serpent, the violent encounter leaves troubled questions about why such a beast was truly stirred.

faq.q: What is Incendia Powder used for?
aliases: why do i need incendia powder
faq.answer: Incendia Powder is an enchanted dust tossed into the sacred fire of life atop Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. Igniting the flame with this mixture summons the vengeful spirit serpent Arikara.

faq.q: Who prepared the enchantment on the powder?
faq.answer: Magatha Grimtotem enchanted the gathered Incendia agave into the refined powder on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, after Motega Firemane of Whitereach Post sent word of Arikara.

faq.q: Where does the powder need to be used?
faq.answer: It must be scattered into the sacred fire pit on a solitary, burial-needle spire within Darkcloud Pinnacle, high above the salt canyons of Thousand Needles.

Magatha Grimtotem fears that changes in tauren lore have angered Arikara and that the serpent may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof. She asks that Arikara be summoned and slain before harm can come to Cairne.

angles.text: The powder demonstrates how elemental flame and spiritual warding can be bound together to awaken slumbering ancestral entities.
Using ritual powders to ignite burial fires reflects the delicate balance between revering sacred traditions and defending the leadership of the tribes.
